snippet.title: Raise, Rise & Die — Official Trailer | Dark fantasy deckbuilder duel
snippet.description:
A dark fantasy card duel where every card you play costs you another one.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4941170/?utm_source=youtube

There is no energy bar, and nothing refills. To play a card, you first
destroy another one from your hand — what you burn out of it is what pays
for the card you actually wanted. Every attack costs you something you
were holding.

And your opponent answers. They can block a card, counter it with one of
their own, or let it through and take the opening it leaves. Both players
keep the top card of their deck face up, so nothing is hidden — you can
see what is coming for you, and so can they.

Two modes: the duel itself, against the AI or another player online with
matchmaking and an Elo ranking, and Arena — an endless run where your deck
size is your maximum health, and the only way to heal is to sacrifice
cards out of that same deck.

Two and a half years of playtesting with real cards on a table before any
of this was code. Every value and every keyword was balanced by hand
there, and none of it was simplified on the way into the engine. The
engine only does the arithmetic, so you never miss a trigger — every
decision worth making stays yours.

Solo developed, in dark pixel art finished by hand. The art is
AI-generated as a starting point, then reworked and integrated by hand.
